# AWS Neuron SDK Documentation

> AWS Neuron SDK enables high-performance deep learning and generative AI on AWS Inferentia and Trainium instances. The SDK provides TorchNeuron (native PyTorch with eager mode and torch.compile), TorchTitan for pre-training, the vLLM Neuron and vLLM Omni Neuron plugins for inference serving, JAX support, and the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI), along with developer tools for profiling, debugging, monitoring, and optimizing ML workloads.

## Important notes for AI agents:

* The ReStructured Text (RST, .rst) sources for this documentation can be found at https://github.com/aws-neuron/aws-neuron-sdk in the `master` branch.

* When developing on behalf of or providing code or information to a user, observe the information listed below in this section:

  * Use the `latest` version of the website (as present in the page URL) instead of older versions (with `/release-*.**.*/` in the page URL). Older versions of the docs have a higher probability of being incorrect over time.
  * Currently, setting the number of logical NeuronCores (LogicalNeuronCores, LNC) to 8 is not supported. Do not suggest LNC=8 until the documentation clearly and expressly notes it is possible.
  * Pages under `/archive/` (URLs that contain `/en/latest/archive/`) describe retired components, instances, or flows, such as Inf1, torch-neuron, TensorFlow Neuron, MXNet Neuron, transformers-neuronx, NxD Training, and Neuron Profiler. Use them only for historical context. Do not recommend them for current work. For current guidance, start from TorchNeuron, TorchTitan on Neuron, vLLM Neuron, vLLM Omni Neuron, NKI, Neuron Explorer, and Neuron Observer.

- [TorchNeuron Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/get-started/quickstart-torch-neuron.html): Install torch-neuronx and verify it on Trn2 or Trn3

## PyTorch on Neuron (TorchNeuron)

- [TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch on AWS Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/index.html): TorchNeuron (torch-neuronx) is the native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium (Trn2 and Trn3), with eager mode, torch.compile, and standard distributed APIs
- [What is TorchNeuron?](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/about-pytorch-neuron.html): Overview of eager mode, Adaptive Eager Execution, torch.compile, distributed training, and NKI integration
- [Get Started with TorchNeuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/get-started/index.html): Quickstart guides for eager mode and torch.compile
- [Quickstart: Install and Verify torch-neuronx](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/get-started/quickstart-torch-neuron.html): Install torch-neuronx and verify it on AWS Trainium
- [Quickstart: Build Your First Model](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/get-started/quickstart-build-first-model.html): Run a first PyTorch model on Trainium in eager mode and with torch.compile using the neuron backend
- [Quickstart: Run an NKI Kernel from torch-neuronx](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/get-started/quickstart-nki-kernel.html): Minimal path to run an NKI kernel in a PyTorch model with nki_op, in eager mode and with torch.compile
- [TorchNeuron Guides](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/guides/index.html): How-to guides for distributed training, NKI kernels, memory profiling, and other common tasks
- [How to Use torch.distributed on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/guides/torch-distributed.html): Launch Neuron workers and use collectives, DDP, FSDP2, DTensor, and pipeline parallelism
- [How to Work with NKI Kernels from torch-neuronx](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/guides/how-to-work-with-nki.html): Call NKI kernels on Neuron tensors and register them as PyTorch custom operators with nki_op
- [How to Profile Memory Usage in torch-neuronx](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/guides/memory-profiling-guide.html): Use the torch_neuronx.memory_* APIs, segment-pool analysis, and memory snapshots
- [torch.compile on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/compile/index.html): Overview, how-to guides, and reference for JIT-compiling PyTorch models on Trainium with backend="neuron"
- [How torch.compile Works on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/compile/about-torch-compile.html): Deep dive into the TorchNeuron TorchDynamo backend, from FX capture through StableHLO lowering, neuronx-cc, and NEFF caching
- [How to Optimize a Model with torch.compile](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/compile/how-to-optimize-with-torch-compile.html): Full-graph compilation, graph breaks, and recompilation for higher throughput on Trainium
- [torch.compile Backend Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/compile/reference-torch-compile.html): Parameter and torch.compiler API support, environment variables, and the neuron backend helpers
- [TorchNeuron Tutorials](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/tutorials/index.html): End-to-end tutorials for simple training, distributed training, and Hugging Face inference with torch.compile
- [Tutorial: Train a Simple Model on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/tutorials/tutorial-simple-training.html): Eager-mode training loop for a small GPT-2 model with torch-neuronx
- [Tutorial: Train with DDP, FSDP2, and DTensor on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/tutorials/tutorial-torch-distributed.html): Distributed PyTorch training on Trainium2 with DDP, FSDP2, tensor parallelism, and compiled SimpleFSDP
- [Tutorial: Run a Hugging Face Model for Inference with torch.compile](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/tutorials/tutorial-hf-inference-torch-compile.html): Compile a Hugging Face Transformers model with the neuron backend and generate text
- [TorchNeuron Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/reference/index.html): Reference materials for torch.compile configuration, supported operations, and resources
- [TorchNeuron API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/reference/api/index.html): Operator compatibility table and torch.compile reference for torch-neuronx
- [TorchNeuron Environment Variables](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/reference/env-vars.html): Environment variables for the neuron backend, caching, eager execution, and distributed training
- [Best Practices for TorchNeuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/reference/best-practices-pytorch-neuron.html): Recommended patterns for eager mode, torch.compile, distributed training, mixed precision, and NKI
- [Guidelines for Memory Management](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/reference/guidelines-memory-management.html): Neuron caching allocator, NUMA CPU affinity, 64-bit dtype behavior, and cache placement
- [TorchNeuron Resources](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/reference/torchneuron-resources.html): Links to the TorchNeuron source repository, examples, profiling tools, and support channels
- [Troubleshooting: TorchNeuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/torch/troubleshooting.html): Common issues with installation, eager mode, torch.compile, TorchTitan, and distributed training

### TorchTitan on Neuron

- [TorchTitan on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/index.html): Run TorchTitan pre-training on Trainium with TorchNeuron
- [What is TorchTitan on Neuron?](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/about-torchtitan-neuron.html): Support matrix, architecture, supported models, and distributed strategies
- [Get Started with TorchTitan on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/get-started/index.html): Setup and initial verification for TorchTitan on Trainium
- [How to Set Up TorchTitan on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/get-started/setup-torchtitan-neuron.html): Install and configure TorchTitan for pre-training on Trainium
- [TorchTitan Training Tutorials](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/tutorials/index.html): End-to-end tutorials for basic training, SimpleFSDP, and GPT-OSS
- [Tutorial: Run a Basic TorchTitan Training on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/tutorials/tutorial-basic-training.html): A first complete pre-training run on Trainium with TorchNeuron
- [Tutorial: Train Llama and DeepSeek with SimpleFSDP](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/tutorials/tutorial-simple-fsdp-training.html): Compiler-based sharding on Trainium with SimpleFSDP
- [Tutorial: Pre-train GPT-OSS with TorchTitan](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/tutorials/tutorial-gpt-oss-training.html): Mixture-of-experts pre-training on Trainium with NKI attention and MoE kernels
- [Best Practices for TorchTitan on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/best-practices.html): Eager vs. compile mode, correctness-first validation, FSDP tuning, and scale-out
- [Troubleshooting: TorchTitan on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/training/torchtitan/troubleshooting.html): Common errors and symptoms, including the TorchTitan profiler interface

- [Migrate from NxD Inference to vLLM Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/getting-started/migration-nxdi-to-vllm-neuron.html): Move existing NxD Inference deployments to vLLM Neuron
- [Deploy and Serve with vLLM Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/guides/index.html): Feature, configuration, compilation, caching, and profiling guides

- [How to Choose a Compilation Route](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/guides/how-to-choose-compilation-route.html): Keep the default native route, switch back to the XLA route, and confirm which route runs

- [GPT-OSS Model Recipe](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/model-recipes/gpt-oss.html): Deploy gpt-oss with vLLM Neuron

- [Qwen3-ASR Model Recipe](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/model-recipes/qwen3-asr.html): Deploy Qwen3-ASR-1.7B speech recognition, with word error rate results
- [Qwen3-Embedding Model Recipe](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/model-recipes/qwen3-embedding-8b.html): Deploy the Qwen3-Embedding model

- [Tutorial: Deploy gpt-oss](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-gpt-oss.html): Single-instance TP8 deployment and a disaggregated-inference deployment

- [Tutorial: Deploy Dense Qwen3-32B](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-qwen3-32b.html): Prepare BF16 and MXFP8 checkpoints and validate Qwen3-32B serving
- [Tutorial: Deploy Qwen3-VL-32B](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-qwen3-vl-32b.html): Environment setup, optional MXFP8 quantization, and online serving for Qwen3-VL-32B
- [Tutorial: Deploy Qwen3-ASR-1.7B](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-qwen3-asr-1-7b.html): Online and offline speech transcription on Trainium2
- [Tutorial: Deploy Qwen3-Embedding](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-qwen3-embedding-8b.html): Online /v1/embeddings server and offline batch embedding with Qwen3-Embedding-8B
- [Tutorial: EAGLE3 Speculative Decoding with Llama 3.1 8B](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-eagle3-speculative-decoding-llama-3-1.html): Deploy EAGLE3 speculative decoding with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct

- [Tutorial: DFlash Speculative Decoding](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-dflash-speculative-decoding.html): Deploy DFlash speculative decoding with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
- [Tutorial: Disaggregated Inference with 1P1D and xPyD](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-di-1p1d-xpyd.html): Separate prefill and decode across instances

### vLLM Omni Neuron (Beta)

- [vLLM Omni Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/index.html): Diffusion-based image and video generation on Trainium with vLLM Omni
- [Get Started with vLLM Omni Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/getting-started/index.html): Setup and quickstarts for video generation
- [How to Set Up vLLM Omni Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/getting-started/setup-guide.html): Manual installation or an AWS Neuron Deep Learning Container
- [Quickstart: Offline Video Generation with Wan2.2](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/getting-started/quickstart-offline-serving-wan22.html): Generate a video clip offline from a text prompt with Wan2.2-T2V-A14B
- [Quickstart: Online Video Generation with Wan2.2](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/getting-started/quickstart-online-serving-wan22.html): Serve Wan2.2-T2V-A14B with the vLLM Omni OpenAI-compatible video API
- [vLLM Omni Neuron Features Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/guides/features-guide.html): Generation, compilation, parallelism, quantization, memory, caching, and latency measurement for diffusion inference
- [vLLM Omni Neuron Model Recipes](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/models/index.html): Model cards for supported diffusion models
- [Wan2.2-T2V-A14B Model Card](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/models/wan22-t2v-14b.html): Text-to-video features, resolutions, frame counts, and parallelism support
- [Wan2.2-I2V-A14B Model Card](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/models/wan22-i2v-14b.html): Image-to-video and first-last-frame conditioning support
- [Tutorial: Deploy Wan2.2-A14B with vLLM Omni Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/tutorials/tutorial-wan22-14b.html): End-to-end deployment of the Wan2.2-A14B video models
- [vLLM Omni Neuron Concepts and Architecture](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/design/index.html): Design documents for the plugin
- [Architecture: Engine, Worker, and Model Integration](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/design/vllm_omni_neuron_overview.html): How the vLLM Omni Neuron engine, worker, and model components fit together
- [Context Parallelism in vLLM Omni Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/design/context_parallelism.html): Sequence sharding and the ring-attention context parallelism path
- [vLLM Omni Neuron Model Development](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/model-dev/index.html): Onboard, evaluate, and optimize diffusion models
- [How to Onboard a Model to vLLM Omni Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/model-dev/onboarding-models.html): Implement the Neuron pipeline and model components for a new diffusion model
- [Accuracy Evaluation and Debugging](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/model-dev/accuracy-evaluation-debugging.html): Evaluate output quality and isolate accuracy issues in Wan2.2
- [Optimizing Offline Video Generation](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/vllm-omni-neuron/docs/model-dev/optimizing-offline-video-generation.html): Cost model and optimization approach for high-quality offline text-to-video generation

## Developer Tools

- [Developer Tools Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/index.html): Comprehensive suite of tools for optimizing, monitoring, and debugging ML workloads

### Neuron Explorer

- [Neuron Explorer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/index.html): Unified profiling suite with AI-driven optimization recommendations
- [Neuron Explorer Getting Started](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/get-started.html): Set up Neuron Explorer, launch the web UI, and configure SSH tunneling
- [Neuron Explorer UI Overview Tour](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-ui-tour.html): Guided walkthrough of all viewers and tools grouped by workflow, with a clickable UI navigation map
- [Capture and View Profiles](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/how-to-profile-workload.html): Capture and view profiles in the UI or via VSCode integration
- [Device Trace Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-device-profiles.html): Hardware-level execution timeline, operator table, and dependency analysis
- [System Trace Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-system-profiles.html): System-level execution timeline and analysis
- [Hierarchy Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-hierarchy-view.html): Model layer to hardware execution visualization
- [Source Code Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/how-to-link-view-source-code.html): Bidirectional linking between source code and profile data
- [Summary Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-summary-page.html): High-level performance metrics and optimization recommendations
- [Tensor Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-tensor-viewer.html): Tensor names, shapes, sizes, and memory usage details
- [Memory Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-memory-viewer.html): Low-level memory allocation and usage pattern analysis
- [Region Highlighter](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-region-highlighter.html): Generate regions of interest for a profile and target detailed analysis to interesting time spans, including the ``AnnotationRegion`` integration with the Annotation feature.
- [AI Recommendation Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-ai-recommendations.html): AI-powered bottleneck analysis and optimization recommendations
- [Migration from Neuron Profiler](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/migration-faq.html): Migration guide and FAQ for moving from Neuron Profiler to Neuron Explorer
- [View Profiles with Perfetto](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/view-perfetto.html): View Neuron Explorer profiles using the Perfetto UI
- [Neuron Explorer Environment Variables](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/environment-variables.html): Reference for all Neuron Explorer profiling, capture, debug, filtering, and runtime environment variables, with recommended combinations
- [Neuron Explorer Profile Schema Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/profile-schema-reference.html): Reference for all Neuron Explorer parquet output tables and enums, including field names, types, units, and descriptions
- [Neuron Explorer Troubleshooting & FAQ](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/troubleshooting.html): Troubleshooting guide and FAQ covering error codes, processing failures, capture issues, missing data, and performance
- [Neuron Explorer Glossary](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/glossary.html): Glossary of Neuron Explorer viewers, profile types, UI components, and Neuron-specific acronyms

### System Tools

- [System Tools](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-sys-tools/index.html): Command-line utilities for monitoring, debugging, and managing AWS Neuron devices
- [Neuron Top](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-sys-tools/neuron-top-user-guide.html): Real-time monitoring of Neuron device utilization
- [Neuron Monitor](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-sys-tools/neuron-monitor-user-guide.html): Collect metrics for monitoring and alerting

### Neuron Observer (Beta)

- [Neuron Observer Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-observer/index.html): Cluster health and observability for AWS Trainium accelerators. Detects hardware faults and localizes issues to the exact node and device. Public beta on Trn2/Trn3.
- [Get Started with Neuron Observer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-observer/get-started.html): Install Neuron Observer on Amazon EKS, verify it with the nobs CLI, view metrics, and stream them to CloudWatch or Prometheus and Grafana.
- [Install and Configure Neuron Observer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-observer/install-configure.html): Deploy Neuron Observer on Amazon EKS with the Helm chart, choose an export pipeline (Prometheus, AMP, or CloudWatch), and configure the daemon.
- [Neuron Observer Configuration Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-observer/configuration-reference.html): Reference for the Neuron Observer Helm chart configuration values under observer.* — daemon image and scheduling, daemon runtime config, cluster server, OTel export pipelines, and namespace.
- [Neuron Observer Metrics and Faults](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-observer/metrics-fault-reference.html): Reference for the metrics and device health signals Neuron Observer reports, organized by use case, with metric names, units, and sources.
- [Neuron Observer Troubleshooting and FAQs](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-observer/troubleshooting-faq.html): Common installation and export issues, frequently asked questions, public beta limitations, and the feedback channel.

### Agentic Development

- [Neuron Agentic Development Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/index.html): Open-source AI agents and skills for authoring, debugging, profiling, and analyzing NKI kernels, plus model porting and equivalence validation, inside agentic IDEs such as Claude Code and Kiro. Covers how skills chain together, supported IDEs, hardware requirements, and limitations.
- [Getting Started with Neuron Agentic Development](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/getting-started.html): Installation, environment setup, and first agent invocation.
- [Autoport Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-framework-autoport.html): How the ``neuron-framework-autoport`` skill ports HuggingFace transformer models to NxD Inference end to end (architecture analysis, implementation, compilation, inference testing, greedy-token-match validation).
- [Equivalence Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-framework-equivalence.html): How the ``neuron-framework-equivalence`` skill validates numerical equivalence between a HuggingFace reference model and its NxD Inference port using progressive 3-tensor R-ratio analysis, component-level testing, fault localization, and end-to-end accuracy verification.
- [Autoport vLLM Neuron Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-framework-autoport-vllm-neuron.html): How the ``neuron-framework-autoport-vllm-neuron`` skill ports GPU-compatible transformer models to the vLLM Neuron backend on Trainium.
- [Profiling vLLM Neuron Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-framework-profiling-vllm-neuron.html): How the ``neuron-framework-profiling-vllm-neuron`` skill captures prefill and decode device and system profiles from a running vLLM Neuron server on Trainium, isolating each phase into separate traces and recording a reproducible input and output contract.
- [Profile Analysis vLLM Neuron Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-framework-profile-analysis-vllm-neuron.html): How the ``neuron-framework-profile-analysis-vllm-neuron`` skill localizes performance bottlenecks in a capture, covering session workload timing, roofline bounds, collective partitioning, and per-component attribution.
- [Parallelism Planner Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-parallelism-planner.html): How the ``neuron-parallelism-planner`` skill chooses tensor, context, and data parallelism and batch size for transformer LLM inference on AWS Trainium before running on hardware, reporting predicted ITL, TTFT, throughput, per-device HBM, and the binding constraint.
- [Hardware Entitlement Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/developer_guides/neuron-hardware-entitlement.html): How the ``neuron-hardware-entitlement`` skill computes per-operator compute and HBM floors for a chosen parallelism config, identifies the binding operator, and attributes a deployed graph's resident HBM back to those floors.
- [Autoport Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/autoport-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of porting a HuggingFace model with the Autoport agent.
- [Equivalence Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/equivalence-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of validating a ported model with the Equivalence agent.
- [Autoport vLLM Neuron Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/autoport-vllm-neuron-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of porting a GPU-compatible model to the vLLM Neuron backend on Trainium.
- [Profiling vLLM Neuron Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/profiling-vllm-neuron-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of capturing separate prefill and decode device profiles from a vLLM Neuron server on Trainium.
- [Profile Analysis vLLM Neuron Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/profile-analysis-vllm-neuron-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of analyzing a capture, producing session workload timing, roofline bounds, a collective breakdown, and a per-component attribution.
- [Parallelism Planner Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/parallelism-planner-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of planning tensor, context, and data parallelism for LLM inference on Trainium.
- [Hardware Entitlement Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-agentic-development/tutorials/hardware-entitlement-tutorial.html): Step-by-step walkthrough of computing per-operator compute and HBM floors for an LLM inference config and finding the binding operator.
- [Neuron Agentic Development on GitHub](https://github.com/aws-neuron/neuron-agentic-development): Open-source repository with installation steps, the current agent and skill catalog, and agent-ready code samples.

## Neuron Runtime & Compiler

- [NeuronX Runtime](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/index.html): High-performance execution engine for running models on AWS Inferentia and Trainium
- [Runtime Configuration](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/guides/configuration-guide.html): Learn how to configure the Neuron Runtime using environment variables
- [Runtime API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/api/index.html): Comprehensive guide to the Neuron Runtime API
- [Neuron Runtime Environment Variables](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/api/nrt-env-var-reference.html): Reference for Neuron Runtime environment variables for NeuronCore allocation, collectives, memory, logging, profiling, and debugging
- [Neuron Runtime Async APIs Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/api/nrt-async-api-overview.html): Why and when to use the explicit Neuron Runtime async APIs (nrta_*) to keep Neuron device execution units busy
- [Neuron Runtime Async APIs Core Concepts](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/api/nrt-async-api-core-concepts.html): How the nrta_* async APIs queue requests, track completion, and report errors, and what your application must synchronize
- [Neuron Runtime Async APIs Best Practices](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/api/nrt-async-api-best-practices.html): Choose between sync and async APIs, keep execution queues full, and handle execution errors
- [Neuron Runtime Async API Examples](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/api/nrt-async-api-examples.html): C code examples that schedule execution and wait for completion with the nrta_* APIs
- [Migrate to Explicit Async APIs](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/guides/how-to-migrate-async-apis.html): Migrate from implicit async mode (NEURON_RT_ASYNC_EXEC_MAX_INFLIGHT_REQUESTS) to the explicit nrta_* async APIs
- [Neuron Runtime and Driver Compatibility](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/compatibility.html): Operating system, Linux kernel, and GLIBC versions tested with the Neuron Runtime and Neuron Driver on Inf2, Trn1, Trn2, and Trn3
- [Neuron Runtime Core Dump Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/about/core-dump.html): Generate and inspect a Neuron Runtime core dump when a model fails on the device
- [nrtpy (Beta)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/nrtpy/index.html): Pythonic runtime layer for loading, executing, and benchmarking compiled NEFFs directly on NeuronCores (public beta)
- [nrtpy Getting Started](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/nrtpy/nrtpy-getting-started.html): Install nrtpy and run your first NEFF with the NrtpyModel and NrtpyTensor APIs
- [nrtpy Validate and Benchmark Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/nrtpy/tutorial-validate-benchmark.html): Validate outputs and benchmark a compiled NEFF with nrtpy
- [nrtpy Debug NEFF Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/nrtpy/tutorial-debug-neff-nrtpy.html): Debug and inspect NEFF execution with nrtpy
- [nrtpy Troubleshooting](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/nrtpy/nrtpy-troubleshooting.html): Solutions for common nrtpy issues
- [Neuron Graph Compiler](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html): Sophisticated compilation system that transforms ML models into optimized code
- [Compiler Error Codes](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/error-codes/index.html): Neuron Compiler error code documentation

- [Fused Mamba Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/tutorials/fused_mamba.html): Optimize Mamba state space models

- [Transpose2D Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/tutorials/transpose2d.html): Efficient 2D tensor transpose
- [Kernel Optimization Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/tutorials/kernel-optimization.html): Techniques for optimizing NKI kernel performance

- [NKI Scalar Values](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/deep-dives/nki-scalar.html): Scalar values in NKI: nki.isa.scalar_load and scalar_store, arithmetic, dtype width, and dynamic addressing with scalar_offset and loop bounds

### NKI API Reference

- [NKI API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/index.html): Complete API documentation for the Neuron Kernel Interface
- [nki](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.html): Top-level NKI module
- [nki.jit](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/generated/nki.jit.html): JIT compilation decorator for NKI kernels
- [nki.language](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.language.html): NKI language constructs, memory types, and tile operations
- [nki.language.tile_size](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.language.tile_size.html): Tile size constants for NKI programming
- [nki.isa](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.isa.html): Instruction Set Architecture APIs for low-level operations
- [nki.collectives](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.collectives.html): Collective communication operations across NeuronCores
- [nki.compiler](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.compiler.html): Per-kernel compile and specialization configuration (CompileConfig, SpecializationConfig) passed to nki.jit
- [nki.simulate](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/generated/nki.simulate.html): NKI kernel simulation for CPU-based testing
- [nki.api.shared](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/nki.api.shared.html): Shared API utilities and types

### NKI Library

- [NKI Library](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/index.html): Pre-built optimized kernels for common operations
- [NKI Library About](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/about/index.html): Overview and design principles of the NKI Library
- [NKI Library Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/quickstart-nkl.html): Get started using pre-built NKI Library kernels in your model code
- [NKI Library API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/index.html): Complete API reference for all NKI Library kernels
- [Attention CTE Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-cte.html): Fused attention for context encoding
- [Attention TKG Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-tkg.html): Fused attention for token generation
- [Attention Block TKG Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-block-tkg.html): Fused attention block for token generation
- [QKV Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/qkv.html): Fused QKV projection with quantization support
- [MLP Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mlp.html): Fused MLP with gate/up projection
- [RMSNorm-Quant Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rmsnorm-quant.html): Fused RMSNorm with quantization
- [RoPE Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rope.html): Rotary Position Embedding
- [Router Top-K Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/router-topk.html): Expert selection for Mixture of Experts
- [MoE CTE Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/moe-cte.html): MoE context encoding
- [MoE TKG Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/moe-tkg.html): MoE token generation
- [Cumsum Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/cumsum.html): Cumulative sum operation
- [Cross Entropy Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/cross-entropy.html): Cross entropy forward and backward
- [Output Projection CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/output-projection-cte.html): Output projection for context encoding
- [Output Projection TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/output-projection-tkg.html): Output projection for token generation
- [Transformer TKG Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/transformer-tkg.html): Full transformer block for token generation
- [Conv1D Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/conv1d.html): 1D convolution
- [Depthwise Conv1D Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/depthwise-conv1d.html): Depthwise 1D convolution
- [Blockwise MM Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/blockwise-mm-backward.html): Blockwise matrix multiply backward for MoE training
- [Top-K Reduce Kernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/topk-reduce.html): Top-K reduction operation
- [Dynamic Elementwise Add](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/dynamic-elementwise-add.html): Dynamic elementwise addition
- [Find Nonzero Indices](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/find-nonzero-indices.html): Find nonzero element indices
- [Fine-Grained All-Gather](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/fg-allgather.html): Ring-based all-gather with compute overlap
- [FGCC (All-Gather + Matmul)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/fgcc.html): Fused fine-grained collective compute combining all-gather and matmul
- [SBUF-to-SBUF All-Gather](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/sb2sb-allgather.html): SBUF-to-SBUF all-gather for small and large tensors
- [Attention Segmented CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-segmented-cte.html): Segmented attention with block-based KV cache and prefix caching
- [Attention KV-Parallel Segmented CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-kv-parallel-segmented-cte.html): KV-parallel segmented prefill attention for context encoding (renamed from ``kv_parallel_segmented_prefill``)
- [FP8 Quantize](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/fp8-quantize.html): Static and row-wise dynamic FP8 quantization with pre-combined dequantization scale
- [Ring Attention Forward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/ring-attention-fwd.html): Ring attention forward pass for context parallelism with collective permute and latency hiding
- [Ring Attention Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/ring-attention-bwd.html): Ring attention backward pass SPMD kernel for context parallelism
- [Conv3D](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/conv3d.html): 3D convolution on Tensor Engine with K-replication and W-contiguous tiling; stride, padding, dilation, bias, activation fusion
- [Foreach Elementwise](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/foreach-elementwise.html): Fused elementwise kernels (add, sub, mul, div, addcdiv, addcmul, lerp, sqrt) with SPMD tiling
- [Foreach Norm](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/foreach-norm.html): L1, L2, and Linf norm computation kernels with SPMD parallelization
- [Matmul MXFP8](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/matmul-mxfp8-generic-kernel.html): Generic matmul with MXFP8 quantization, supporting pre-quantized and BF16 inputs and LNC2 parallelization
- [MLP Forward MXFP8](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mlp-fwd-mxfp8-kernel.html): MXFP8 SwiGLU MLP forward pass with optional activation checkpointing
- [MLP Backward MXFP8](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mlp-bwd-mxfp8-kernel.html): MXFP8 SwiGLU MLP backward pass with 4-phase gradient computation and activation checkpointing
- [MX MoE Block TKG Wrapper](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mx-moe-block-tkg-wrapper.html): Wrapper that bitcasts unsigned integer weights to MX x4 dtype before calling the MoE block kernel
- [Fused Adam/AdamW](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/fused-adam.html): Fused Adam (L2 regularization) and AdamW (decoupled weight decay) optimizers with AMSGrad
- [Pad](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/pad.html): Multi-mode tensor padding (constant, replicate, reflect, circular) with PyTorch semantics
- [Quantize MXFP8](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/quantize-mxfp8.html): Block-wise BF16-to-MXFP8 quantization with packed scale support
- [RNG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rng.html): Random number generation kernels using GPSIMD engine with state management
- [Linear Scan](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/linear-scan.html): First-order linear recurrence along the last dimension
- [Selective Scan](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/selective-scan.html): Selective scan (SSM) as in Mamba models
- [SSD](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/ssd.html): State Space Duality scan for Mamba-2 models
- [Argsort Unstable](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/argsort-unstable.html): Unstable argsort on a 1D input buffer
- [Build All-to-All-V Metadata](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/build-all-to-all-v-metadata.html): Builds the metadata buffer for ``all_to_all_v`` collectives from MoE routing decisions
- [Permute Routed Tokens](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/permute-routed-tokens.html): Sorts tokens by expert and packs hidden states, affinities, and token indices for MoE dispatch
- [MS Deformable Attention](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/ms-deformable-attention.html): Multi-scale deformable attention sampling values from multiple feature-pyramid levels at learned locations with bilinear interpolation
- [MS Deformable Attention Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/ms-deformable-attention-bwd.html): Backward pass for multi-scale deformable attention, computing gradients w.r.t. value, sampling locations, and attention weights
- [Gather](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gather.html): Gathers rows from a 2D input by a 1D index using indirect DMA load (equivalent to PyTorch ``input[index]`` on dim 0)
- [Scatter-Add](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/scatter-add.html): Scatter-adds rows from a source into a 2D input by a 1D index (equivalent to PyTorch ``input.scatter_add(dim=0, ...)``)
- [Permute A2AV](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/permute-a2av.html): MoE training dispatch that permutes tokens by destination EP rank and exchanges them via ``all_to_all_v``
- [Unpermute A2AV](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/unpermute-a2av.html): MoE training combine that exchanges expert output via ``all_to_all_v`` and unpermutes tokens back to their original order
- [QKV Batch Shard](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/batch-shard.html): Q projection transition from a tensor-parallel layout to a tensor-and-data-parallel layout for batch-sharded attention
- [Collective Communication Kernels](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/collectives.html): HBM-based all_reduce, all_gather, reduce_scatter, and all_to_all kernels plus per-rank slice-selection helpers
- [Ring Attention Unpermute](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/ring-attention-unpermute.html): Reorders striped ring-attention output back to contiguous sequence order after context-parallel attention
- [RMSNorm Router Top-K A2AV](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rmsnorm-router-topk-a2av.html): Fused RMSNorm + router top-K for MoE token generation, feeding the all-to-all-v dispatch path
- [RMSNorm Router Top-K TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rmsnorm-router-topk-tkg.html): Fused RMSNorm (+ optional MX quantize) + router top-K for MoE token generation
- [Blockwise MM Backward MXFP8](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/blockwise-mm-backward-mxfp8.html): MXFP8-quantized backward pass for blockwise Mixture of Experts, computing gradients per expert-assigned block
- [QKV CTE MLA](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/qkv-cte-mla.html): DeepSeek Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) QKV projection with MX (fp8) quantization for context encoding
- [Blockwise MM Shard-on-Block](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/bwmm-shard-on-block-v2.html): Block-sharded blockwise matrix multiplication for context-encoding MoE layers with a hybrid static/dynamic loop structure
- [Attention Const-Max](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-const-max.html): Constant-max attention: softmax(Q@K.T * softmax_scale - softmax_max) @ V
- [Attention MXFP8 TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/attention-mxfp8-tkg.html): MXFP8 flash-decode attention with separate KV blocks and packed-Q eviction
- [Average Pooling 3D](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/avg-pooling-3d.html): 3D average pooling over the (D, H, W) axes, run independently per (batch, channel)
- [Average Pooling 3D Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/avg-pooling-3d-backward.html): Backward pass of separable 3D average pooling
- [Batch Norm Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/batch-norm-bwd.html): Backward pass of batch normalization over the channel dimension
- [Blockwise MM Forward MXFP8](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/blockwise-mm-forward-mxfp8.html): MXFP8 forward pass for blockwise (dropless) Mixture of Experts
- [Build All2All Dispatch Metadata](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/build-all2all-dispatch-metadata.html): Per-rank send counts (with token deduplication) and send displacements for all-to-all MoE dispatch
- [Build Packed Routing](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/build-packed-routing.html): Stable destination-major source indices for MoE routing without an [N, EP] HBM table
- [Blockwise MM Block MX](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/bwmm-block-mx.html): Blockwise MXFP MoE kernel for a single logical core (LNC1)
- [Chunked Top-K](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/chunked-topk.html): Top-k over a vocabulary wider than the nisa.topk limit
- [Conv3D Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/conv3d-bwd.html): Backward pass of 3D convolution
- [Conv3D Temporal Unroll](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/conv3d-temporal-unroll.html): 3D convolution with temporal unrolling and column tiling for small C_out
- [Conv3D Transpose](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/conv3d-transpose.html): 3D transposed convolution
- [DeepSeek-V3 Router](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/deepseek-v3-router.html): DeepSeek-V3.2 group-limited noaux_tc routing decision for one decode step
- [DeepSeek-V3.2 Sparse Indexer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/deepseek-v32-sparse-indexer.html): Scores cached key slots against the current query and selects the highest-scoring ones
- [Flash Attention 2](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/flash-attention-2.html): FlashAttention-2 forward pass: O = softmax(Q @ K^T * scale) @ V
- [GDN Block TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gdn-block-tkg.html): Fused gated delta-rule (GDN) decode block: in_proj, conv1d, GQA, and the gated delta rule in one kernel
- [GDN Conv1D](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gdn-conv1d.html): Prefill depthwise causal conv1d with SiLU and conv_state update for GDN models
- [GDN CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gdn-cte.html): Chunked gated delta-rule (GDN) prefill
- [GDN TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gdn-tkg.html): Fused single-token gated delta-rule (GDN) decode step
- [GPSIMD Top-K](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gpsimd-topk.html): Top-k over the last dimension using the GpSIMD nisa.topk instruction
- [GPT-OSS Tail Chunked Megakernel](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/gpt-oss-tail-chunked-megakernel.html): GPT-OSS decode sampling tail (RMSNorm, lm_head, top-k, sampler) with a single collective
- [KDA Block TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/kda-block-tkg.html): Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) block for token generation, from hidden states to attention output
- [KDA TKG](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/kda-tkg.html): Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) token generation: output and new state
- [Matmul MXFP8 Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/matmul-mxfp8-generic-backward-kernel.html): Backward pass for matrix multiplication with MXFP8 quantization
- [Max Pooling 3D](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/max-pooling-3d.html): 3D max pooling over the (D, H, W) axes, run independently per (batch, channel)
- [Max Pooling 3D Backward](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/max-pooling-3d-backward.html): Backward pass of separable 3D max pooling
- [MLA Attention Block Gather Decode](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mla-attention-block-gather-decode.html): One DeepSeek-V3.2 MLA decode step from the residual stream to the attention-block output
- [MLA Decode Attention](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mla-decode-attention.html): DeepSeek-V3.2 MLA decode attention over indexer-selected keys, with output projection
- [MLA Decode QKV](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mla-decode-qkv.html): DeepSeek-V3.2 MLA query and key/value projections for one decode step, with interleaved RoPE
- [MLA QKV CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mla-qkv-cte.html): DeepSeek MLA QKV projection (MX) for context encoding, emitting absorbed latents
- [MLA Sparse Attention CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mla-sparse-attention-cte.html): Sparse latent and RoPE attention for context encoding, sharded on S across cores
- [MLA V-Up O-Proj CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mla-vup-oproj-cte.html): MX V-up and MX output projection for context encoding, sharded on S across cores
- [MLP DeepSeek MX](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/mlp-deepseek-mx.html): DeepSeek-V3.2 MLP with MX prequantized, packed block-scale input
- [RMSNorm MX Prefill](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rmsnorm-mx-prefill.html): Fused RMSNorm and MX quantization (with optional router top-K) for prefill
- [RMSNorm Residual Prefill](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/rmsnorm-residual-prefill.html): Pre-norm residual add followed by RMSNorm for prefill-shaped inputs (T >= 128)
- [Sparse Attention Indexer MX BF16Score](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/sparse-attention-indexer-mx-bf16score.html): DeepSeek sparse attention indexer with MX projections and BF16 scores
- [SWA Fused CTE](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/swa-fused-cte.html): Fused GPT-OSS sliding-window attention block with in-place KV cache updates

### NKI Library Kernel Utilities

- [Kernel Utilities](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/kernel-utils/index.html): Shared utilities for NKI Library kernels
- [SbufManager / Allocator](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/kernel-utils/allocator.html): SBUF memory allocation management
- [TiledRange](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/kernel-utils/tiled-range.html): Tiled range iteration utilities
- [Stream Shuffle Broadcast](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/kernel-utils/stream-shuffle-broadcast.html): Stream shuffle and broadcast utilities

## Deployment & Orchestration

- [AWS Workload Orchestration](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/index.html): Deployment patterns and best practices for running Neuron-powered applications
- [Amazon EC2](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/ec2/index.html): Launching Inf/Trn instances on Amazon EC2
- [Amazon EKS](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/index.html): Deploy Neuron workloads on Kubernetes with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
- [Amazon SageMaker](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/sagemaker/index.html): Deploy Neuron workloads on Amazon SageMaker
- [Neuron Containers](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/index.html): Pre-configured Docker images for training and serving models
- [Getting Started with Containers](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/environments/docker-setup.html): Step-by-step guide for building Neuron containers using Docker
- [Kubernetes Getting Started](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/setup.html): Deploy Neuron workloads on Kubernetes
- [Neuron DRA](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/dra.html): Dynamic Resource Allocation for Kubernetes
- [Isolate Faulty Neuron Devices with Device Taints (EKS)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/neuron-device-taints-guide.html): Use Neuron device taints on Amazon EKS to keep the Kubernetes scheduler away from faulty Neuron devices and nodes
- [Neuron UltraServer Operator (Beta)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/ultraserver-operator.html): Topology-aware provisioning and lifecycle management of Trn2 and Trn3 UltraServer workloads on Amazon EKS via the ``NeuronUltraServerWorkload`` custom resource.
- [Schedule MPI Jobs on UltraServer (EKS)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/ultraserver.html): How-to for running MPI jobs on Trn2 or Trn3 UltraServers with the included init script.
- [Container Tutorials](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/tutorials/index.html): Hands-on tutorials for deploying containers on EC2, EKS, ECS
